picks.why: Talen trades at 11.8x forward earnings with a 6% FCF yield and 96% revenue growth, and today's seven-year 750 MW capacity deal with an investment-grade buyer locks in cash flow. It is the cleanest overweight-segment name on the shortlist and adds a second power generator beside VST.
picks.risk: If Constellation's view that the US has years of untapped power is right, capacity prices and Talen's premium fall.

picks.why: Lam has a 40% operating margin, 54% revenue growth and trades at 18.2x forward earnings after falling 49% from its high. TSMC's 60% October sales growth says wafer-capacity spending continues, which feeds etch and deposition orders.
picks.risk: A memory capex cut, given memory is the weakest segment, or new China export curbs would hit Lam's orders.
